nodes.text:
Perhaps some day you and Daniel will feel the pain of people in my family dealing with childhood prediabetes and autism. 
I have not heard you speaking about the massive exposure of the US population to uncontrolled immigration and the diseases coming along for the ride. I know that you mean well. My family also bore the brunt of the economic disaster from Los Angeles public policy during the COVID era. Daniel has spoken about this to some extent. Bankruptcy is painful. Delayed speech is painful. 
The Great Barrington Declaration was a reasonable approach. Censorship as swift and decisive and wrong.
